lines.text: While Jesus prays in private, the disciples say the crowds call Him John the Baptist, Elijah, or a prophet of old.
Jesus asks who the disciples say He is, and Peter answers that He is the Prophet of God.
Jesus warns them to tell no one, and says the Son of Man must suffer, be killed, and be raised on the third day.
Jesus tells all of them that anyone who wants to follow Him must deny himself and take up his staff daily.
Jesus says the Son of Man will be ashamed of those ashamed of Him, and some standing there will see God's kingdom.
